description: Input is polymorphic on `type` (Stream|Reference) and its `datasource` (Blob, EventHub, IoTHub, ...) and `serialization` (Json, Csv, Avro, ...) are polymorphic too; the converted model drops `datasource` entirely and keeps only `serialization.type`, so S.Struct strips the payload on encode and decode. Add them as untyped documents.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Input data source (polymorphic on `type`, e.g. `Microsoft.Storage/Blob`) with its type-specific `properties`.

Serialization-type-specific properties (e.g. `{ encoding: "UTF8", format: "LineSeparated" }` for Json).
